_about: Who lives where, and what they say. 'show' maps a level to a condition; 'talk' is checked top to bottom and the first entry whose 'when' holds is used. Conditions are flag names joined by '&', with '!' for not. Flags: met_<id> (set by talking), told_arc, told_howl, seen_<cutscene>, w1_clear to w4_clear, clear_<level> (set by the game). An entry with 'at' is only used in that level. A person with 'gifts' keeps the Pips (Dot): each gift is given once when that many Pips are home ('at' -1 means all of them), and a 'progress' line says how many are home ({home}, {total}, {need}). 'set' flags are set when the conversation ends. 'shop' opens the shop after the lines.

lines: THE LINE RANG THREE TIMES THIS MORNING, AND WHEN I PICKED UP, EVERY STATION WAS CALLING AT ONCE.
YOU FOUND WHO WAS CALLING, AND YOU BROUGHT THEM ALL HOME. LAST RELAY ISN'T THE LAST OF ANYTHING NOW.
THE GROUND HAS BEEN SHAKING ALL NIGHT, AND THE HOWL SOUNDS CLOSER THAN IT EVER HAS BEFORE.
WHATEVER IS WAITING DOWN THERE, MAKE SURE YOU COME BACK UP. WE KEPT YOUR PLACE HERE TOO.
YOU ARRIVED ALONG THE WIRE LAST NIGHT, AFTER THE DEAD LINE RANG, AND YOU'VE BEEN ASLEEP EVER SINCE.
THIS IS *LAST RELAY*, THE ONLY STATION STILL HUMMING ANYWHERE ON THE LINE AFTER ALL THESE YEARS.
SOMEBODY OUT THERE KEEPS CALLING US, THREE RINGS AND THEN A VOICE THAT NONE OF US CAN UNDERSTAND.
THE CALL COMES FROM PAST THE GATES, AND THE GATES ONLY OPEN FOR SIGNAL, NEVER FOR LISTENERS LIKE US.
BUT YOU'RE A SPARK, MADE OF SIGNAL YOURSELF, SO FOLLOW THE LINE AND DISCOVER WHO IS CALLING.
AND IF YOU HEAR A TINY VOICE IN THE GLASS ON THE POLES, THAT'S A *PIP*. DOT AT THE SWITCHBOARD WILL WANT IT HOME.
WHEN THE GATE LIT UP, SOME OF ITS ENERGY JUMPED ONTO YOU, AND IT'S STILL CRACKLING AROUND YOU NOW.
THAT ENERGY IS AN *ARC*, AND YOU CAN THROW IT TO KNOCK OUT ANY ENEMY AHEAD OF YOU, EVEN SPIKY ONES.
IT ALSO BREAKS *CRACKED WALLS*, AND PEOPLE HID ALL KINDS OF TREASURE INSIDE THEM DURING THE QUIET.
BUT I FELT THE GROUND SHIVER WHEN THE GATE LIT. THE OLD CREWS WOULD SAY THE *HOWL* WAS STIRRING DOWN THERE.
YOU'VE CROSSED THREE WHOLE WORLDS AND TRAVELLED FURTHER DOWN THE LINE THAN ANY LISTENER EVER HAS.
THESE DAYS THE CALL COMES FROM UNDERGROUND, FROM A PLACE THE OLD CREWS NICKNAMED *DEAD AIR*.
NOTHING DOWN THERE MAKES A SOUND, AND NOTHING MAKES ANY LIGHT, SO PLEASE BE VERY CAREFUL.
THE HOWL GROWS LOUDER EVERY NIGHT, AND IF IT RISES UP THE LINE AGAIN, THERE'S NOTHING LEFT TO CUT.
THE RELAY IS FINALLY QUIET, AND LAST NIGHT I SLEPT PEACEFULLY FOR THE FIRST TIME IN YEARS.
THE CALL IS CLEARER NOW, TOO, AND WREN IS WAITING IN THE *RADIO SHACK* TO TELL YOU EVERYTHING.
YOU LIT THE FIRST GATE, AND ALREADY THE CALL SOUNDS LOUDER AND CLEARER THAN EVER BEFORE.
IT'S COMING FROM BEYOND THE SWITCHYARD NOW, AND WREN HAS BEEN LISTENING TO IT ALL NIGHT.
THE LINE STARTS AT THE *SIGNPOST* AT THE EAST END OF THE VILLAGE, SO LISTEN CAREFULLY AS YOU TRAVEL.
COLLECT ANY *SHARDS* YOU FIND ALONG THE WAY, BECAUSE TALLY WILL TRADE YOU USEFUL PARTS FOR THEM.
VISITORS FROM EVERY STATION, AND EVERY SINGLE ONE OF THEM WANTS PARTS! BUSINESS HAS NEVER BEEN BETTER.
WELL, A CUSTOMER AT LAST, AND A GENUINE SPARK! I'M TALLY, AND I KEEP COUNT OF EVERYTHING.
*SHARDS* ARE PROPER SIGNAL, AND PROPER SIGNAL IS VERY HARD TO FIND THESE DAYS.
EVERYTHING IS PRICED IN SHARDS, SO HAVE A LOOK AROUND. SORRY, BUT THERE ARE NO DISCOUNTS FOR SPARKS!
WELCOME BACK, MY FAVOURITE CUSTOMER, AND LET'S SEE WHAT YOUR SHARDS CAN BUY TODAY.
MY RADIO HASN'T STOPPED ALL DAY. EVERY STATION ON THE LINE IS TALKING AT ONCE, AND I LOVE IT.
SO THAT'S WHERE HOME IS, FOR SOMETHING LIKE YOU. IT'S EVERYWHERE THE LINE GOES.
THE CALL CHANGED LAST NIGHT, AND FOR THE VERY FIRST TIME, IT SOUNDED WORRIED.
THE RING WON'T CLOSE WITHOUT YOU, SPARK. PLEASE HURRY, BECAUSE WE CAN'T HOLD THE NOISE MUCH LONGER.
A RING WITH A GAP IN IT, AND YOU'RE THE MISSING PIECE. THAT'S WHY THEY KEPT YOUR PLACE.
A REAL, LIVING SPARK, OUT ON THE FLATS! I'M WREN, AND I'M FOLLOWING THE MYSTERIOUS CALL TOO.
I CAME OUT HERE TO GET CLOSER TO IT, BUT THE FLOOR KEPT CRUMBLING AWAY UNDERNEATH ME.
I'VE WRITTEN DOWN EVERY SOUND IT MAKES, AND NOW I'M CERTAIN IT ISN'T RANDOM STATIC. IT'S WORDS!
I'M HEADING HOME TO LAST RELAY NOW, SO COME AND FIND ME IN THE *RADIO SHACK* LATER.
WHEN YOU LIT THE SPIRE, THE CALL CAME THROUGH PERFECTLY, EVERY SINGLE WORD OF IT.
SPARK, COME HOME. WE KEPT YOUR PLACE.
THEY SAID WE, SO THERE ARE MANY CALLERS DOWN THERE, AND THEY'VE BEEN SAVING A PLACE FOR YOU.
BUT HOW COULD THEY POSSIBLY KNOW YOU, WHEN YOU DON'T REMEMBER ANY OF THEM?
LAST NIGHT, FOR THE FIRST TIME EVER, THE CALL CAME THROUGH CLEARLY ENOUGH TO UNDERSTAND.
IT SAYS: SPARK, COME HOME.
SO THE CALL WAS MEANT FOR YOU ALL ALONG. BUT WHERE EXACTLY IS HOME, FOR SOMETHING LIKE YOU?
SINCE YOU LIT THE GATE, THE CALL HAS BEEN CLEARER, AND I'M ALMOST CERTAIN IT BEGINS WITH A NAME.
THE NAME STARTS WITH S-P BEFORE IT BREAKS OFF, AND I'VE FILLED AN ENTIRE NOTEBOOK WITH GUESSES.
I'M STILL STUDYING THE CALL, BUT ALL I CAN HEAR IS HALF A WORD, REPEATING OVER AND OVER.
IF YOU LIGHT *THE GATE* AT THE END OF THE FLATS, MAYBE I'LL FINALLY UNDERSTAND THE WHOLE MESSAGE.
I PULLED MY HANDLE THE OTHER WAY THIS MORNING, AND FOR THE FIRST TIME IN YEARS, THE LINE IS WHOLE.
WE CUT IT TO KEEP EVERYONE SAFE, AND YOU JOINED IT BACK TOGETHER. THANK YOU, LITTLE SPARK.
YOU MADE IT DOWN TO DEAD AIR. I CAME AHEAD OF YOU, BECAUSE I KNOW THESE TUNNELS BETTER THAN ANYONE.
MY CREW CUT THE WIRE YOU WERE LYING ON, SPARK. NOW I'M HERE TO HELP YOU JOIN IT BACK TOGETHER.
THOSE BOXES ARE *RELAY TURRETS*. THEY STILL FIRE AT ANY SIGNAL, BECAUSE THEY THINK IT'S THE NOISE.
WATCH FOR THE EYE THAT LIGHTS UP BEFORE EACH SHOT, AND JUMP OVER THE BOLTS AS THEY COME.
CAREFUL IN HERE, BECAUSE THE OLD CREWS CUT THESE LINES ON PURPOSE, AND I WAS ONE OF THOSE WORKERS.
WE DIDN'T DO IT TO HURT ANYONE, BUT TO STOP THE NOISE SPREADING FROM STATION TO STATION.
SEE THE HANDLE ON MY BELT? ONE PULL CUTS OFF A LINE, SO ONE PROBLEM CAN'T TAKE DOWN EVERYTHING.
GET THROUGH *THE GATE* AT THE END OF THIS CORRIDOR, AND I'LL MEET YOU AT LAST RELAY AFTERWARDS.
WE CREWS HAD A NAME FOR THAT NOISE. WE CALLED IT *THE HOWL*, BECAUSE IT SWALLOWED EVERY VOICE IT TOUCHED.
IF THE HOWL IS STIRRING AGAIN, THEN CUTTING THE LINES ONLY PUT IT TO SLEEP. IT NEVER REALLY WENT AWAY.
YOU BLEW THE RELAY'S FUSES? GOOD, BECAUSE IT WAS NEVER GOING TO STOP BY ITSELF.
A MACHINE THAT CAN'T STOP PROTECTING ITSELF ISN'T PROTECTING ANYONE AT ALL.
SOMETIMES I WONDER IF WE CREWS WERE THE SAME, CUTTING EVERY LINE AND CALLING IT SAFE.
THE SWITCHYARD SPLITS THE LINE INTO TWO *CHANNELS*, AND WHEN ONE CHANNEL IS LIVE, THE OTHER IS DEAD.
THAT'S HOW WE KEPT THE NOISE OUT, AND IT MOSTLY WORKED, BUT NOBODY DISCOVERED WHERE IT CAME FROM.
BLINK, BLINK! THAT'S HOW WE SAID HELLO ON THE SWITCHBOARD. I'M DOT, AND I CONNECTED EVERY CALL ON THE LINE.
EVERY VOICE WAS CARRIED BY A *PIP*, A TINY SPARK OF SIGNAL. A BIT LIKE YOU, ONLY MUCH SMALLER.
WHEN THE CREWS CUT THE LINE, MY PIPS WERE CAUGHT IN THE GLASS ON THE OLD POLES, AND THEY'RE STILL THERE.
LISTEN FOR THEM CALLING. TOUCH THE GLASS TO SET ONE FREE, AND IT WILL COME STRAIGHT HOME TO ME.
BRING ENOUGH OF THEM HOME AND I'LL HAVE SOMETHING FOR YOU. MY *SWITCHBOARD* CAN ALSO SEND YOU ANYWHERE YOU'VE BEEN.
BLINK, BLINK, BLINK! EVERY LINE ON MY SWITCHBOARD IS RINGING AT ONCE, AND I'M CONNECTING CALLS AGAIN.
THE PIPS HAVE BEEN WHISPERING ALL NIGHT. THEY SAY THE CALL COMES FROM A PLACE WITH NO LIGHT AT ALL.
BLINK, BLINK! THE PIPS YOU FREED ARE HELPING ME CONNECT THE VILLAGE AGAIN, ONE LITTLE CALL AT A TIME.
FIVE PIPS HOME ALREADY! HERE, TAKE THIS SPARE CELL. IT'S AN *EXTRA LIFE*.
TEN PIPS! TAKE MY OLD *PIP TUNER*. OUT ON THE LINE IT POINTS TO THE NEAREST PIP STILL TRAPPED.
EIGHTEEN! THE PIPS WANT TO KEEP YOU SAFE, SO FROM NOW ON YOU START EVERY GAME WITH *ONE MORE LIFE*.
TWENTY-SEVEN! LISTEN TO THEM CHEER. THAT'S *ANOTHER LIFE* TO START EVERY GAME WITH.
EVERY SINGLE PIP IS HOME. I NEVER THOUGHT I'D HEAR THIS SWITCHBOARD SO FULL AGAIN.
WHEN YOU REACH THE CALLER AT LAST, WE'LL ALL ANSWER TOGETHER. YOU WON'T BE ALONE.

progress.next: {home} OF {total} PIPS ARE HOME. BRING ME {need} MORE AND I'LL HAVE ANOTHER GIFT FOR YOU.
progress.rest: {home} OF {total} PIPS ARE HOME. LISTEN FOR THE REST, STILL CALLING IN THE GLASS.
progress.all: ALL {total} PIPS ARE HOME. THANK YOU, LITTLE SPARK.

lines: THE RELAY WOKE UP THIS MORNING, BUT GENTLY THIS TIME, JUST PASSING CALLS ALONG LIKE IT USED TO.
DID YOU TELL THE CALLERS THAT HUM SAYS HELLO? I THINK THEY HEARD ME ANYWAY.
HELLO, LITTLE SPARK. FORGIVE ME, BUT I HAVEN'T SLEPT A WINK SINCE THE LINE WAS CUT.
THAT RELAY AHEAD HAS BEEN SWAPPING ITS CHANNELS EVERY FEW SECONDS, NIGHT AND DAY, FOR YEARS.
IT'S STILL TRYING TO KEEP THE NOISE OUT, AND IT'S SLOWLY SHAKING ITSELF APART TO DO IT.
PLEASE BUMP ITS THREE *FUSES* FROM BELOW TO BLOW THEM, SO IT CAN FINALLY REST, AND SO CAN I.
CAN YOU HEAR THAT? ABSOLUTELY NOTHING, AND IT'S THE FIRST PEACEFUL NIGHT I'VE HAD IN YEARS.
THANK YOU, LITTLE SPARK, AND WHEN YOU FIND WHOEVER IS CALLING, PLEASE TELL THEM HUM SAYS HELLO.
EVERY MAST ON THE LINE IS GLOWING TONIGHT, AND NOT ONE OF THEM IS STANDING ALONE ANY MORE.
HOLD ON TO SOMETHING! UP HERE, THE WIND NEVER ASKS PERMISSION BEFORE IT SHOVES YOU.
I'M SPIRE, AND I KEPT THESE MASTS AND AERIALS STANDING ALL ALONE, ALL THROUGH THE QUIET.
THE WIND ARRIVES IN *GUSTS*. THE STREAKS BUNCH TOGETHER BEFORE EACH ONE, SO MOVE DURING THE CALM.
THE CALL YOU'RE CHASING BOUNCES OFF THE SPIRE'S TOP, SO WHOEVER IS CALLING IS BELOW US, NOT ABOVE.
WHEN YOU'RE FINISHED HERE, COME AND VISIT ME AT LAST RELAY, WHERE I'LL BE WAITING BY THE *SIGNPOST*.
WHEN YOU LIT THE SPIRE, EVERYBODY IN THE VILLAGE WATCHED IT GLOWING LIKE A BRAND NEW STAR.
FROM HERE, THE LINE DIVES UNDERNEATH THE OLD EXCHANGE, WHERE THERE'S NO WIND AND NO LIGHT EITHER.
I KEPT THOSE MASTS STANDING ALONE FOR YEARS AND CALLED IT STRENGTH, BUT HAVING FRIENDS IS BETTER.
THE SPIRE IS THE TALLEST THING STILL STANDING ANYWHERE ON THE LINE.
CLIMB TO THE VERY TOP AND LIGHT IT, AND EVERY STATION ALONG THE LINE WILL HEAR YOU CALLING.
